text: fileIdentity now digests path|fileKey only. creationTime removed: sun.nio.fs.UnixFileAttributes.creationTime() falls back to lastModifiedTime() wherever birthtime is unsupported (Linux), so it changed on every append and invalidated every live cursor; on macOS/APFS it added nothing fileKey did not already provide, since a replaced file gets a new inode. Evidence: three new LocalLogReaderSuite tests -- cursor survives an append across a modification-time tick with identity unchanged, follow delivers two pages written after the stream started, and delete+recreate still invalidates the cursor. Truncation detection unchanged (size check). 7/7 on macOS; the append test can only fail on a fallback platform, and CI runs ubuntu-22.04, so that is where it becomes a live regression guard.
